parsed.explanation: Worst exposure is a Tier-1 universal rule: restrooms in government buildings, schools, universities and prisons must match birth-certificate sex, backed by large facility fines, documented trooper ID checks within days, and a DOJ records investigation of a school district. No effective remedy is shown; the state also bans marker changes on licences/birth certificates, lacks statewide gender-identity anti-discrimination and hate-crime cover, and frames trans access as a women's-privacy threat. Nationally, binary passport rules, document-discrepancy fraud referrals, allied travel advisories, and documented abusive custody practices amplify border/custody risk if outed or arrested for bathroom trespass. Mitigants keeping it above severe levels: no offence for trans presentation itself, no organised sweeps, some courts enjoining national orders, local opposition, and recorded killings near general background rates rather than a campaign.
